[EN] Bear Meat
[ES] Carne de oso
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill {@creature:47#1001#Tirkai grizzlies} in the {@Rgn:47002$$Whitefrost Forest} southeast of {@Rgn:77001$$Pathfinder Post} and collect their meat.
[ES] Mata a los {@creature:47#1001#grizzlies de Tirkai} en el {@Rgn:47002$$Bosque de la Escarcha Blanca}, al sureste del {@Rgn:77001$$Puesto del Explorador}, y consigue su carne.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to {@Rgn:47006$$Field Base Lunacy} and deliver the bear meat to {@creature:247#1001$$Jadora}.
[ES] Ve a la {@Rgn:47006$$Base de operaciones de Lunacy} y entrégale la carne de oso a {@creature:247#1001$$Jadora}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Salt it really well."
[ES] "Sálala muy bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
